name: UNSTIRRED WATER BATH
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Unstirred Water Bath is a fundamental general-purpose constant temperature instrument utilized in clinical, educational, and microbiological labs. It is perfect for safely warming reagents, melting agar, and incubating sample tubes. Designed with a robust double-walled structure, 5-sided glass wool insulation, and an advanced digital PID controller, it provides an incredibly stable, vibration-free heating environment with minimal maintenance.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Unstirred Water Bath operates as a high-precision still-water thermostatic vessel employing an immersion-type stainless steel heater regulated by an advanced microprocessor PID controller with auto-tuning and a PT100 RTD sensor. It maintains a uniform, vibration-free thermal environment from ambient +10°C to 100°C with ±0.5°C stability by minimizing convective turbulence and insulating all five sides with glass wool. In clinical, educational, and research laboratories, doctors and B.Sc/M.Sc students use it to warm blood bank reagents, thaw serum/plasma samples, digest sputum specimens, melt selective agars such as MacConkey agar and Sabouraud dextrose agar at 45–50°C, and incubate microbiological broths for coliform testing. PhD researchers and chemists rely on it for temperature-sensitive sample preparation such as dissolving ammonium persulfate, equilibrating SDS-PAGE sample buffers, digesting proteins in strong acids within sealed PTFE vessels, and controlled evaporation of non-corrosive solvents. It supports routine ISO/ASTM methodologies requiring stable water-bath incubation, including ISO 6888-1 for coagulase-positive staphylococci, ASTM D1293 for pH buffer equilibration, and general good laboratory practice for serological and enzymatic assays.
sop: Ensure the water bath is placed on a level surface and filled with clean distilled or deionized water up to 50 mm below the rim; never operate dry.
Connect the power supply to 220 Volts 50 Hz and switch ON the mains; the LED displays will show the Process Value and Set Value.
Press the 'SET' button once. The Set Value display will flash.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter (e.g., 37°C for coliform incubation or 56°C for serum inactivation).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value. The PID controller will auto-tune and heat the water, maintaining the set temperature.
Wait for the Process Value to stabilize at the Set Value ±0.5°C before placing samples; use the perforated stainless steel tray to keep tubes and flasks upright and properly submerged.
Periodically check the water level; top up with warm distilled water if required to prevent exposure of the heating element.
After use, switch OFF the mains, unplug the unit, allow the water to cool completely, drain the tank, and wipe dry with a soft cloth to prevent corrosion or microbial growth.

Safety Warning: NEVER place volatile, toxic, or strong acid reagents directly into the water bath without sealed secondary containment; avoid touching hot surfaces and always use heat-resistant gloves, as escaping steam and boiling water can cause severe burns.
